checks.note: The excerpt is verbatim, and the citations and outcome are correct. But the proposition ('Major AI lenders, especially SMBC and MUFG, are points of failure') leaves out a factual part of the statement: that both banks 'aggressively loaned to just about every part of the AI economy'. The support condition tests exactly this (substantial lending across major AI layers), so the headline says less than the speaker committed to. 'Major AI lenders' also turns 'common names' (lenders that recur across deals) into a different category.

In context, 'they' means the hyperscalers, so the proposition is faithful. The horizon, $2T threshold and annual-vs-cumulative ambiguity are all visible. The rationale matches Bain's conditional, industry-scope estimate (e1, e2), and the citations are accurate. One small point: the limitation's 'partial preview' wording rests on the packet note that read_page returned PARTIAL, not on an evidence item. That is acceptable process context.
